remarks:
This 14 acre property is located in Gainesville NY, Wyoming County and features a triangular shape lot with road frontage on both Hardys Road and Shearing Road.

While a portion of the land consists of DEC-protected wetlands, there is still ample space near the road to build a home or cabin.  Electric is available at the road making development more accessible.

The property is mostly level and is surrounded by some farmland creating a peaceful, rural setting.  It would make an excellent getaway spot for enjoying nature, as well as a great opportunity for hunting, trapping, or recreational use.  Wildlife is abundant with deer, beaver, and other animals frequently seen on the property.

Total annual taxes are $659.61.

The property is located 15 minutes from Letchworth State Park, 1 hour from Buffalo NY, 1 hour 10 minutes from Rochester NY, and 15 minutes from Warsaw NY.
